profile.name: Pablo Uribe Montoya
profile.title: Full-stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-stack Software Engineer with 7 years of professional experience in backend development using .NET/C#. Experience building microservices, RESTful/SOAP APIs, and IoT solutions on Azure and AWS. Comfortable applying architectural patterns, automated testing, and Agile methodologies. Multilingual professional with strong technical communication abilities.

highlights: Built RESTful APIs using .NET Core and C#
Processed and modeled data with SQL Server and LINQ
Applied Dependency Injection, Repository Pattern, and Builder Pattern
Maintained and supported SOAP and RESTful APIs in production
Supported legacy applications and worked on AI-assisted development with Claude Code and GitHub Copilot
Built RESTful APIs and microservices under .NET Core, using Azure Service Bus for service-to-service communication
Web project: maintained tables and stored procedures in SQL Server; worked on the frontend with React

IoT project: built .NET 6.0 modules on Docker/Azure IoT Edge; used MQTT (Mosquitto) for communication; implemented Azure Direct Methods for remote camera control; built an image-processing module with Python and Azure Custom Vision
DataHub project: built AWS Lambda functions to process files from S3, storing data and routing it to multiple API endpoints
Applied the CQRS pattern and modern CI/CD tooling
Built a RESTful API using Node.js and Hapi.js
Developed cross-platform Video-on-Demand (VOD) applications for major US media clients
Used C++11 and the Signal/Slot pattern for concurrent programming across Xbox, PS4, Roku, Fire TV, Apple TV, iOS, and Android

volunteer.description: Technical support volunteer for a .NET bootcamp organized by Women Who Code, Pioneras Dev, and Perficient
